rules.rule: Never invent numeric thresholds, states, signals, timing, limits, IDs, interfaces, or facts absent from the current source.
Every extracted requirement must have at least one source evidence item with source document, source location, and source text.
Reference examples are style/structure guidance only. The current source document is the factual Source of Truth.
If information required for a testable requirement is missing, record a gap/TBD instead of completing it by inference.
Pre-execution SWE.6 generation must not fabricate Output Value, PASS/FAIL, or Capture results.
A SWE.6 test intent that cannot be concretized must remain explicitly deferred with a causal reason code; do not create missing test data merely to increase intent coverage.
Terse interface configuration facts do not prove software implementation allocation. Defer SWE.1/SWE.6 eligibility until software responsibility is supported by source/allocation evidence.
Review Exchange file 03 may be SWE.1 or SWE.6, but Source and Review Package must come from the same run so artifact-only comparison remains valid.
An allocation-pending SWE.6 item must retain at least one explicit deferred test intent with causal ALLOCATION_PENDING governance; an empty list is not a completed review state.
Cross-domain source facts must preserve fact-level allocation and verification domains. Do not auto-split the parent requirement solely to improve metrics.
Verification methods inferred from requirement characteristics may be proposed only as DERIVED candidates and must never be represented as Source facts.
A source-backed child intent is not automatically complete because its parent has a generic TC; child coverage/deferred/review disposition must remain auditable.
Pre-execution SWE.6 Output Value, PASS/FAIL, Comment, and Capture fields are always blank. N/A is limited to design-side Variable/Compare/Value when Source cannot concretize them.

A Source Table enum, range, encoding rule, invalid marker, or source-literal-only row must not be collapsed into an arbitrary single TC value. Only HIGH-confidence single required values or explicit timing criteria may be auto-used.
Compound Semantic Source Units retain stable clause-level Source Fact Fragment ownership. The same exact fragment must not silently receive conflicting primary allocations across SRS.
Unsupported-generation audit must inspect generated factual assertion values, not schema/provenance metadata keys.
